gaps.capability: Unified A Route observation demand/request control handoff
gaps.why_required_for_A: Without it, Intent/Task/Safety need cannot govern whether any provider should observe, and frame arrival can remain an accidental trigger.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Controlled integration of existing Field Perception Orchestrator into A Route demand/request lifecycle; do not create parallel owner.
gaps.stop_condition: One bounded demand creates one scoped request or explicit NO_DEMAND/DEFER/STOP outcome with trace.

gaps.why_required_for_A: Model confidence and observation admission cannot determine whether the task-relevant information need is satisfied or whether more observation is justified.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Add a narrow sufficiency contract/adapter consumed by Active Observation Control; preserve uncertainty, contradiction, temporal scope and source independence.
gaps.stop_condition: For a bounded need, output explicit sufficient/insufficient/contested/stale plus a governed control candidate.

gaps.why_required_for_A: Current model/provider and runtime assets provide candidates and admission contracts but no proven product handoff that starts only on demand and stops on sufficiency, cancellation, budget, failure, or target loss.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Future controlled runtime integration around existing owners; provider autonomy remains false by default.
gaps.stop_condition: Provider session is scoped, budgeted, traceable, revocable, and cannot self-start or self-extend.

gaps.why_required_for_A: Contradictory observations currently have preservation and reconsideration references, but not a product-level choice among confirmation, redirect, switch, defer, and stop.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Typed adapter from contradiction/sufficiency output to bounded Field Perception/A Route reconsideration.
gaps.stop_condition: Contradiction triggers one bounded control candidate with depth/idempotency guard.

gaps.why_required_for_A: Vision may suggest OCR and spatial need may suggest SLAM, but no canonical policy closes which additional capability is necessary and when to stop.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Controlled follow-up request adapter keyed to information need and scope; no provider-to-provider direct launch.
gaps.stop_condition: Additional capability is requested only with explicit need, scope, budget, and admission refs.

gaps.why_required_for_A: Safety observation can have priority, but baseline safety must not become an unbounded always-on provider exception.
gaps.recommended_module_or_extension: Typed safety observation admission contract with scope, duration, resource, trace, revocation, and policy owner.
gaps.stop_condition: Safety exception is explicit, bounded, policy-governed, resource-governed, traceable, and revocable.
